# Sanchar Sharma

> Theoretical physicist and junior group leader specializing in quantum magnonics and cavity opto-magnonics. Based at IFIMAC – Condensed Matter Physics Center, Universidad Autónoma de Madrid, Spain. Funded by the "la Caixa" Foundation.

## About

Sanchar Sharma studies the quantum dynamics of ferromagnets, with the long-term goal of harnessing magnons — quasiparticles of spin waves in ferromagnets — for quantum applications such as interconnects, transduction between microwave and optical frequencies, and logic operations. His theoretical work spans magnon-microwave and magnon-photon interactions, quantum state generation and tomography of magnons, cavity optomagnonic coupling, and the quantum properties of magnetic skyrmions.

## Research Areas

- **Quantum Magnonics**: non-classical states of magnons (spin cat states, Fock states, superpositions), quantum sensing of magnons using Brillouin light scattering, magnon-mediated quantum gates for superconducting qubits, cavity magnonics
- **Cavity Opto-magnonics**: magnon-photon coupling, microwave-to-optical transduction, optomagnonic crystals, optical cooling of magnons, light scattering by magnons in whispering gallery mode cavities
- **Quantum Skyrmions**: optical signatures of quantum magnetic skyrmions, quantization of the helicity mode

- [Protocol for generating an arbitrary quantum state of the magnetization in cavity magnonics](https://doi.org/10.1088/2515-7639/ac81f0) — Sanchar Sharma, VASV Bittencourt, S Viola Kusminskiy, Journal of Physics: Materials (2022)

- [Design of an optomagnonic crystal: Towards optimal magnon-photon mode matching at the microscale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.06638) — J Graf, Sanchar Sharma, H Hübl, S Viola Kusminskiy, Phys. Rev. Res. (2021)
- [Optimal mode matching in cavity optomagnonics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.04720) — Sanchar Sharma, BZ Rameshti, YM Blanter, GEW Bauer, Phys. Rev. B (2020)

- [Light scattering by magnons in whispering gallery mode cavities](https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.02499) — Sanchar Sharma, YM Blanter, GEW Bauer, Phys. Rev. B (2017)

- "la Caixa" Junior Group Leader — IFIMAC, Universidad Autónoma de Madrid, Madrid, Spain (Sep 2025 – present)
- Postdoctoral Researcher — Laboratoire de Physique de l'École Normale Supérieure (LPENS), Paris, France (Apr 2024 – Aug 2025)
- Postdoctoral Researcher — RWTH Aachen, Aachen, Germany (Jan 2023 – Mar 2024)
- Postdoctoral Researcher — Max Planck Institute for the Science of Light (MPL), Erlangen, Germany (Nov 2019 – Dec 2022)
- PhD in Applied Physics — Delft University of Technology (TU Delft), Delft, Netherlands (Aug 2015 – Aug 2019)
- B.Tech + M.Tech — Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT-B), Mumbai, India (Aug 2010 – Jun 2015)
